newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror sees 96 EPS $1.45 to $1.50.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror sees 96 EPS $1.45 to $1.50.

text.p: Times Mirror Co said it expects 1996 earnings to be $1.45 to $1.50 per share, a roughly 70 percent improvement from the $0.84 per share earned in 1995.
Times Mirror Chairman Mark Willes said the company is targeting earnings growth of 40 percent in 1997 and 30 percent in 1998.
In 1999 and beyond he said the company aspires to 10 percent annual earnings growth.
He also said, in remarks at a PaineWebber conference, that the Los Angeles company's restructuring is "basically finished."
According to the Zack's Investment Research consensus forecast Wall Street is expecting Times Mirror to net $1.47 per share.
Times Mirror shares were were down 5/8 at 51-3/4 in mid-morning NYSE trade.
